crossRefs.note: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

people.name: Zabdi
people.line: Ancestor of Achan, who sinned against Israel

people.name: Zerah
people.line: Son of Judah, twin of Perez

translations.web: He brought near the family of Judah, and he selected the family of the Zerahites. He brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was selected.
translations.bsb: He had the clans of Judah come forward, and the clan of the Zerahites was selected. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward, and the family of Zabdi was selected.
translations.kjv: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:
translations.asv: and he brought near the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zerahites: and he brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:
